scopes.timing: Nine fresh complete cold changing-population searches per task; three archived environmental controls; ASGP drift is separate from frozen denominators.
scopes.process: Process wall includes import/audit/export and excludes lock waiting; never substituted for evolve_wall_ms.
scopes.stages: Diagnostic stage sums/medians are attribution indicators. Overlap and accounting differ: do not add them as an exact wall-time decomposition or bound.
scopes.semantics: Compare complete result dictionaries and full final/history AST exports, recursively ignoring ONLY *_ms, *_bytes and execution_profile. Timing/memory diagnostics alone are excluded.
scopes.historical_modes: All18new GPU-e/ER searches are compared to same task/mode/seed/generations/repeat historical controls, with original binary/settings recorded. Historical controls are semantic references only and excluded from current timing medians.
scopes.quality: Exact 128-generation trajectories across three seeds establish preservation, not improved convergence. All errors, timeouts, rejections, unique genomes and emitted CPU audit coverage remain visible.
scopes.memory: RSS is process peak from /usr/bin/time; genotype_device_bytes is reported genotype allocation, not total GPU peak.
scopes.scaling: Fixed-parent warmup plus three measured generations; ratios use each task/population own ASGP control, never frozen full-search denominators.
scopes.snapshot: All1024initial programs ×1024cases; inherited4House CPU/GPU fitness differences must remain exactly unchanged.
